title: The idea that refused to stay on paper
sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
about: The gap between the world you imagine and the material you have to make it. A small paper boat escapes a blank page and survives an ocean; the final reveal shows this world was made from a brief and edited in AutoPromote.
whyCare: Everyone has an idea they cannot yet turn into something others can see. The fragile boat makes that struggle visible.
hook: A paper boat on a desk moves as the desk becomes an ocean. Impossible but immediately readable.
beginning: A single ordinary sheet becomes a boat; one idea, no footage.
development: The boat becomes the central subject of a much larger cinematic world.
tension: A dark wave threatens the fragile boat. Will the idea survive becoming real?
payoff: A warm path of light opens across the ocean; the boat survives. The camera reveals the created world as editable material in the real AutoPromote Studio.
ending: The finished world fills the screen again: A brief. No footage. AutoPromote.
withheld: The origin of the footage and the AutoPromote identity until the payoff.
amplify: The small boat against the dark wave
The reveal of this exact footage in the real Studio
soundDirection: Dry paper texture and a restrained ticking pulse at the desk; ocean and a low tense swell for the storm; a deliberate near-silence before a warm harmonic resolution. Original instrumental score, no imitation voice or placeholder beeps.
reviewCriteria: Storm feels threatening without chaotic geometry
AutoPromote reveal uses actual product UI
